description:
Generate a high-resolution, photorealistic product image of [product name]. The product should appear premium, clean, and professionally photographed.

Main Style: Ultra-sharp studio shot with soft lighting and pure white background (#FFFFFF).

Details to capture:



– Exact shape, texture, and material of the product



– Accurate reflection, shadow, and depth



– Realistic colors and proportions



– No logos, copyright designs, or text

Composition Requirements:



– Center the product



– Include realistic, soft shadow under the product



– Avoid distortions, fingerprints, or imperfections

Camera & Quality Specs:



– 8K resolution, f/1.8 aperture, 85mm focal length



– Professional product lighting



– DSLR depth-of-field realism

Output Variants:



– 📌 Front view



– 📌 Side view



– 📌 45-degree angle hero shot



– 📌 Lifestyle image: the product in a real-world use setting

Make sure the final image looks like it belongs on a premium e-commerce or dropshipping marketplace. So this is the prompt But I want to add on to this and I want it to create 7 different styled image so also addition to that also add the prompts for them?
